$Comment: Martha the Cook, the feast's host, standing in the Forgotten Temple while Harvest Feast runs. The
role, this placement and the conversation pressing F opens all ship in this pack. Interact names
the conversation (Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Host.json) rather than a screen, because
the host has quests and lines to say before any list opens. Author Dialogue or Open, never both.
Season is what makes the host a guest: the placement stands only while the calendar event
Harvest_Feast is switched on and running, so the host arrives when it starts and leaves when it
ends, is stopped by a command, or is switched off. The library looks at every placement again at
each start and end, so neither needs a restart. Lifecycle keeps the host's chunk loaded (which is
also what lets the end of the feast find the host and clear the spot), stands the host up again
if something removes the host, and raises the host's health past anything that can be dealt.
Where finds the temple by its GameplayConfig id, which stays the same on every visit while the
world's name does not. This placement authors no Identity.NpcId, so the character IS the role: the
feast's quests bind to Harvest_Feast_Host.
Anchor is the temple's arrival spot plus an offset: four blocks along negative X, onto the open
landing, and two back along negative Z, across the landing from Old Jack's spot, so the two hosts
never share a spot even when a server owner moves a season's days. To move the host, edit
Anchor.WorldSpawn.Offset (small enough to stay off the walls) and Yaw to turn the host, then look
at the spot in game. To take the host out without editing this file, set enabled (lower case, as
that file spells it) to false for this id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json.
Props are the feast's supper table, drawn while Martha stands: a tavern table in front of her and a
bench across it turned to face her, each offset from her spot along the world's own axes and raised
half a block (Y 0.5), because a block is drawn centred on the point it is given.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Host_Temple
